fieldName: Chance of an offer per bar
fieldDescription: Chance in percent that a bar has a tiered mission on offer. Each bar rolls again when its offers refresh, about every 20 to 40 days.

How much the tier roll favours tiers that match your fleet size, colony income and credits. 0 is fully random. 100 makes the matching tier twice as likely and its neighbours one and a half times. Every tier in the range below stays possible.
Bars never offer contracts below this tier. If it is set above the highest tier, the two swap.
Bars never offer contracts above this tier.

Raid a market to knock out one of its industries, or bring your marines to a garrison.
Haul supplies to a camp in an uncolonised system.
Defend a market of the client's faction from an attack.
Buy the location of a named ship.
Sell a client the hull they want, or buy a ship from them.
Capture a market for the client's faction. Tier 3 and up, needs Nexerelin.
Buy the location of a debris field.

Multiplies the size of every enemy fleet.

Multiplies the pay of fuel runs, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the pay of crew transport, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the pay of contributions, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the profit of investments, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the pay of combat contracts, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the pay of raids and garrison duty, on top of the reward multiplier.

Multiplies what clients pay for ships you bring them, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the pay of conquest contracts, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the value of the common goods in salvage lead debris fields.

Every bar gets an extra option to spawn any job type at any tier, ignoring the job type and tier settings above, and open contracts get buttons to complete or fail them at once. Leave it off for normal play.
